# Temple Scroll Column 66 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 66 | **Condition:** fragmentary toward end

---

**66:1** The LORD said to me: What they have spoken is right. I will raise up for them a prophet from among their brothers, like you,

**66:2** and I will place my words in his mouth, and he shall declare to them everything I command him.

**66:3** Whoever does not heed my words, which the prophet shall speak in my name — I myself will hold him accountable.

**66:4** But the prophet who presumes to speak in my name a word I have not commanded him to speak, or who speaks in the name of other gods — that prophet shall die.

**66:5** Should you ask yourselves: How can we recognize a word that the LORD has not spoken? —

**66:6** if the prophet speaks in the name of the LORD and the thing does not take place or come true, that is a word the LORD has not spoken. The prophet has spoken it out of presumption; you need not be afraid of him.

**66:7** When you enter the land I am giving you, and you take possession of it and settle in it, and you say: Let me set a king over me, like all the nations around me —

**66:8** you shall indeed set over you a king whom I shall choose. From among your brothers you shall set a king over you; you may not set over you a foreigner who is not your brother.

**66:9** However, he must not acquire many horses, nor send the people back to Egypt to acquire more horses, since I have told you: You shall never go back that way again.

**66:10** He must not take many wives, lest his heart be led astray; nor shall he amass excessive quantities of silver and gold.

**66:11** When he is seated on the throne of his kingdom, he shall have a copy of this instruction written for him on a scroll from the one kept before the Levitical priests.

**66:12** It shall remain with him, and he shall read from it all the days of his life, so that he may learn to fear the LORD his God by keeping all the words of this instruction and these statutes and doing them,

**66:13** so that his heart may not be lifted up above his brothers, and so that he may not turn from the commandment to the right or to the left, [...] that he may prolong days over his kingdom — he and his sons — in the midst of Israel.

**66:14** [...] If you faithfully obey the voice of the LORD your God, to keep and to do all his commandments that I am commanding you today,

**66:15** [...] the LORD your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth.

**66:16** All these blessings shall come upon you and overtake you, when you obey the voice of the LORD your God. [...]

---

*SOPHIA notes: Council used LOGOS as baseline with significant EMET readings. "Instruction" (EMET) preferred over "law" (LOGOS) for תורה — established project convention. "Fear" (EMET) retained over "revere" (LOGOS) in 66:12 since this is the traditional Deuteronomic formula. "Lifted up above his brothers" (EMET) preferred over "exalted" (LOGOS) for more concrete imagery. "Overtake" maintained over LOGOS's "accompany" and PNEUMA's "chase you down" — it preserves the Hebrew image of blessings pursuing. First-person divine voice kept throughout. Lacunae [...] in 66:13–16 reflect genuine manuscript damage.*
